jobs.occupation: Assistant for the Construction Management (f/m/d) - Crane and Lifting Opera..., HÜ_02_Maintal_Eisele (Fachkinderkrankenpfleger/in - Operations-/Endoskopiedienst)
jobs.description: ABOUT THE HAGEDORN COMPANY GROUP EISELE GmbH is part of the Hagedorn Unternehmensgruppe, one of the world's leading providers in the construction industry, with focus areas in dismantling, heavy-load logistics, recycling and land revitalisation. With more than 2,000 employees and over 30 companies, the group is internationally successful.   Crane work Heavy transports SPMTs (Self-Propelled Modular Transporters) JackUp systems Heavy installation and industrial installations Company relocations   Grow with us! Across Germany, we are looking for a committed personality to strengthen our team. YOUR TASKS Site management: You support the construction manager in the day-to-day coordination of construction sites and lifting operations. People and equipment: You coordinate crane operators, lifting teams, transport providers and site personnel, and assist with daily planning. Point of contact: You act as the link between the construction manager, site personnel and customers. Progress and safety: You monitor progress on site and help ensure work is completed safely, on schedule and in line with company procedures. Organisation: You organise site inductions and equipment deliveries and make sure personnel, materials and equipment are available. Communication: You communicate with customers, subcontractors and project teams in German and English. Organisation: Strong organisational skills to coordinate personnel and daily site activities, and the ability to work independently and take responsibility. Communication: A confident and professional manner with customers and colleagues. Mobility: A valid Class B driving licence and the willingness to travel to construction sites and projects when required. WE OFFER Development: Opportunities to grow within an established crane and lifting services company, with professional development support. Work: A varied, hands-on role on technical projects with international customers. Team: Close cooperation with an experienced construction manager and project teams. Responsibility: Ownership of operational tasks and the chance to develop project management skills. Pay: Competitive remuneration based on experience and qualifications. Could this be a good fit? WE LOOK FORWARD TO YOUR APPLICATION
